title: WhatsApp: links, new tab, name, fixed in its corner with the safe area; fixed while scrolling and under the cookie notice at 1280 and 402
description: The floating estrategia-web/whatsapp button with the cookie notice (two blocks of this plugin that share the bottom corner of a phone), on the whatsapp seed page (a long page with a button with attributes and one with the site option). One load at 1280; 402 is a resize. Read by browser-whatsapp. It was whatsapp.test.mjs (level 3) until 29-10-2026.

values.box: (() => { const r = document.querySelector('.estrategia-web-whatsapp')?.getBoundingClientRect(); return r && { left: Math.round(r.left), bottom: Math.round(innerHeight - r.bottom), width: Math.round(r.width), height: Math.round(r.height) }; })()
values.covered: (() => { const a = document.querySelector('.estrategia-web-whatsapp').getBoundingClientRect(); const notice = document.querySelector('#estrategia-web-consent'); if (!notice || !notice.getBoundingClientRect().height) return 'no notice'; const n = notice.getBoundingClientRect(); const x = Math.max(a.left, n.left) + 1; const y = Math.max(a.top, n.top) + 1; const overlap = x < Math.min(a.right, n.right) && y < Math.min(a.bottom, n.bottom); return overlap ? (notice.contains(document.elementFromPoint(x, y)) ? 'notice on top' : 'button on top') : 'no overlap'; })()
values.insets: (() => { const found = {}; const walk = (rules) => { for (const rule of rules) { if (rule.cssRules) walk(rule.cssRules); if (!rule.selectorText || !rule.selectorText.includes('.estrategia-web-whatsapp')) continue; for (const prop of ['inset-block-end', 'inset-inline-start', 'inset-inline-end']) { const value = rule.style.getPropertyValue(prop); if (value) found[rule.selectorText + ' ' + prop] = value; } } }; for (const sheet of document.styleSheets) { try { walk(sheet.cssRules); } catch {} } return found; })()
